product.title: Key West Sandbar Charter With Kayak Tour: Includes Lunch & Drinks

description.text: Get ready to spend a half-day soaking up the sun and enjoying Key West’s diverse ecology during this fun sandbar and mangrove tour. Discover the backcountry waters and secluded sandbars around the busy island, all while sipping on cold drinks. This guided kayak ecotour takes you into the mangrove isles to spot dazzling marine life before heading to a sandy beach to knock back a few alcoholic or nonalcoholic beverages.Ditch the crowds and enjoy time spent on a secluded sandbar All snorkeling and kayaling equipment is included Wade into the mangroves where more than 500 species live Savor unlimi Ideal for travelers basing in Key West who want a guided Florida Keys experience without coordinating boats, gear, or launch times on their own.
